description: National Inventory Submissions, 2017, UNFCCC is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Industrial demand > Overview", published or maintained by unfccc.int (publisher inferred from the link). Direct emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases occur both from fossil fuel combustion for process heat and from chemical processes (e.g. calcination in cement manufacture or iron ore reduction in steel manufacturing). Indirect emissions come from e.g. the use of electricity. Furthermore, industry products may include embedded carbon, e.g. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Industrial demand" lists it under "Overview". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support industrial demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
